_about: Single source for the hiring-funnel gates and the funnel diagnosis rules. Read by scripts/actions.py (injected into the dashboard) and described in prose in references/framework.md. Edit here, not in the page.

gates.name: Positioning
gates.when_it_leaks: Applications go to roles that don't fit the level or domain. Re-run the market stage with a narrower target.

gates.name: Findable
gates.decides: Recruiter search on LinkedIn and job boards
gates.decides_on: Keyword search and filters: title, city, Open to Work
gates.when_it_leaks: Few profile views or recruiter InMails. Fix the headline, skills, location and Open to Work, then re-run the ATS score for LinkedIn.

gates.name: Parseable
gates.decides_on: Text extraction, keyword match, knockout questions
gates.when_it_leaks: Applications get no response at all. Re-score against the actual JDs applied to, and tailor the summary and skills order per JD.

gates.name: Shortlisted
gates.decides_on: Title, years, location, employer, gaps, obvious fit
gates.when_it_leaks: Responses come, but no screening calls. Make the first third of the page answer 'is this a fit', explain gaps, and lean on referrals.

gates.name: Interview invite
gates.when_it_leaks: Screens happen, but no technical interviews follow. Add outcome numbers and ownership, and make the level claimed match the evidence.

gates.name: Technical pass
gates.when_it_leaks: Technical rounds fail. Pull the mock-interview reports, study the lowest-scoring dimension, and drop claims that can't be defended.

gates.name: Manager round
gates.when_it_leaks: Finals don't become offers. Rehearse the story bank out loud, and check that the stories show ownership and real numbers.

gates.name: Offer
gates.when_it_leaks: Offers stall or come in low. Check level calibration, research the band, and confirm notice-period flexibility before the final round.

gates.name: Background check
gates.decides_on: Titles, dates, employers, education against records
gates.when_it_leaks: An offer is delayed or withdrawn after verification. Reconcile every date and title with letters and EPFO records before the next offer.

funnel._about: Columns of outputs/funnel.md, in order. 'gate' is what a low conversion INTO this column points at.
funnel._rule: Heuristic, not a benchmark: once a stage has min_volume at its 'from' column, the leaking gate is the first stage with zero conversion; else the stage furthest below its 'floor' (a warning line, not a target); else, among two or more ready stages that have no floor, the lowest conversion. A stage at or above its floor is never called a leak. The floor lets a single ready stage be flagged early in a search, when only applications have enough volume. Compare the candidate against their own previous weeks.
